title: TaxRate

external_id.description: The merchant-set ID for this tax rate, which can be used to link it in the `PosNormalizedMenu`.

name.description: The name of the tax rate shown in Grubhub menu management user interfaces.

rate.description: Decimal tax rate. Must be between 0 and 1. This object must have a value for either this field or the `flat` field.

flat.description: The absolute amount of tax applied to orders from this merchant. This object must have a value for either this field or the `rate` field.

description: Information about a tax rate in a normalized menu format. Tax rate to be applied at order checkout, if the diner is not tax-exempt. The tax rate listed here applies only to the items and modifiers with which it is associated. All other menu items will use the merchant tax rate.
